description: This Java source file defines the ImageHandler class, which implements handlers for storing and retrieving image data related to complex observations in the OpenMRS medical record system. The class supports reading images from storage, saving images to storage, and determining supported image formats based on file extensions.

classes.name: ImageHandler
classes.description: Handles storing and retrieving image data associated with complex observations, supporting image formats supported by ImageIO, and integrating with OpenMRS's storage service.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves image data for a specific observation and view; supports raw image display.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns an array of supported view identifiers, currently only RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves image data from an observation to persistent storage and updates the observation's complex data reference.
